spec: Two same-size public 7264-parameter microGPT checkpoints, 3 hash splits, 2 artificial client layouts, frozen real first block and second attention, cached full FFN activations for fitting/audit, ReLU not SwiGLU. Train-only feature ranks, 32 train/8 test names per client, 4 clients 2 logical edges, 40 synchronous steps, 8 samples/client/step, CE half hard/half teacher, beta .3 single-token overlap, exact heldout two-token EAL, no generated trajectories or actual sparse kernel. Global deep down coefficients averaged across all clients; shared shallow coefficients by edge; shuffled same capacity, global one coefficient set. deep 32 retained columns no q correction, separate q-only correction with 32-k formal columns, formal p-only shallow correction (no overlap gradient), joint p/q share same shallow correction and overlap gradient, global/shuffled same joint objective. Not matched total model storage vs global, deep-only and separate effective formal capacities differ; 32 columns per local path max; no full model training, physical HFL, GPU, wall time, CI. Formal target changed, not lossless teacher. All features dense offline, sparse counts only theoretical. Independent weights repeated seeds not independently pretrained.
